children: Saratoga Investment entered into an Underwriting Agreement to issue an additional $23.1 million of its 8.00% Notes due 2031, increasing the series to about $120.8 million outstanding. The notes, priced at 99.6% with quarterly interest and maturing August 31, 2031, are fungible with existing SAX notes. Net proceeds of approximately $22.52 million will be used to repay a portion of the Valley National Bank special purpose vehicle credit facility. The transaction closed on September 24, 2026.
: Underwriting agreement for public notes offering
: Repay a portion of Valley Credit Facility
